likelyEliminators.relaxation: Lower the floor in small steps.

likelyEliminators.label: Score availability and strength
likelyEliminators.whyItMatters: Requires a usable composite evidence base.
likelyEliminators.relaxation: Inspect score gaps before lowering the threshold.

likelyEliminators.label: Dividend signal
likelyEliminators.whyItMatters: Highlights income coverage candidates for conservative review.

likelyEliminators.whyItMatters: Flags balance sheets that may be less exposed to financing stress.

likelyEliminators.label: Liquidity and solvency resilience
likelyEliminators.whyItMatters: Keeps distress signals out of the default preset.
likelyEliminators.relaxation: Allow GREY only with explicit review notes.

likelyEliminators.label: Data completeness
likelyEliminators.whyItMatters: Missing provider or internal calculations must be explainable.
likelyEliminators.relaxation: Keep missing-data labels visible when filters are relaxed.

suggestedRelaxations: Lower the margin-of-safety floor before removing quality or solvency checks.
Allow narrow moat or stable share-count results when wide-moat buyback candidates are too scarce.
Temporarily remove the dividend yield filter for durable compounders that reinvest rather than distribute cash.
Keep unavailable score or source coverage visible instead of treating missing data as a pass.
decisionSupportNote: The current criteria are preserved. Suggested relaxations are research alternatives, not automated changes.
